subject: Maths
topic_line: Help JJ & Mikey find the treasure!
intro_voice: Hi friends! I'm JJ, and this is Mikey! Welcome to Fraction Falls. Answer five questions, collect five gems, and we find the treasure! Ready? Let's go!
outro_voice: Woohoo! All five gems! You found the treasure! You're a maths superstar. See you next time!

questions.q: 1 whole is cut into 3 equal parts. One part is…
questions.explain: 3 equal parts, so one part is one-third.
questions.voice_q: A pizza is cut into 3 equal parts. What is one part called?
questions.voice_a: It's one-third! One of 3 equal parts is one-third.

questions.q: 1 whole is cut into 2 equal parts. One part is…
questions.explain: 2 equal parts, so one part is half.
questions.voice_q: A pizza is cut into 2 equal parts. What is one part called?
questions.voice_a: It's half! One of 2 equal parts is half.
